Re-measured on Bench(60,160) fast (taken clip frames, the bench's own reading): in-band 14 is 0.3088 with every part, 0.1449 without the two bridge straps (gap 68.26 -> 84.65, +16.39 points), and 0.033 for the hubs and links alone (gap 95.84). bridge_a has 208 samples at 100 % in band (median 3.92 mm) and bridge_b 216 at 52 %; link 1 (357 samples) is at 1.7 %, link 2 (322) at 0.7 %, hub 2 at 0 % (its level is 151 mm from GH). The sample-weighted in-band rewards any static, well-fitting strap added to a design: the score rises while the parts that move with the arm float as far from the skin as before. Without the bridge this design would read 84.65, 15.7 points behind the champion baseline's 68.93 (whose own part split is not on file, so this is a watch, not proof).
